request.style: English, male voice, gritty solo with backing choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, light percussion, mournful mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tola son of Puah stood up
A man of Issachar by blood
He rose to deliver Israel
From the weight of the flood
He lived in Shamir the hill
In the country of Ephraim still
A place where the shadows lie
And the quiet winds blow by

[Chorus]
He judged Israel twenty-three years
And then he died and was buried there
In Shamir the hill country of Ephraim
Resting in the earth so deep and dim

[Verse]
He maintained the law and order
In times of peace and calm
No great wars to fight or fear
Just the daily toil and work
The minor judge among them all
Keeping the people true
In the hill country of Ephraim
Where the roots run deep and blue

[Chorus]
He judged Israel twenty-three years
And then he died and was buried there
In Shamir the hill country of Ephraim
Resting in the earth so deep and dim

[Bridge]
After Abimelech he rose
To stand in the justice line
Tola son of Puah known
In the heart of Issachar's vine

[Outro]
He judged Israel twenty-three years
And then he died and was buried there
